headline: A 2004 executive order on encouraging federal agencies to work with others on conservation efforts.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order aims to make it easier for the federal government to work together with others on conservation of land, water, and wildlife. Only the title was provided, so details about specific rules, partners, or programs cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle conservation and natural resources
who_it_affects.how: The title suggests these agencies are directed to support cooperative conservation work, but the exact requirements are not given in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 26, 2004; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
